pets.appearance: Radiant phoenix rising from golden embers, feathers of fire in crimson orange and gold, wings spread wide trailing sparks and light, dark dawn sky background, epic fantasy art, glowing and triumphant
pets.favourite: dawn after long nights, warm ashes, and second chances
pets.form: phoenix of ember and gold, reborn from every failed build
pets.name: Phoenix
quirks: treats every rollback as a rebirth ceremony
glows brighter right after the worst failures

failure: Good. Ashes. Phoenix knows this part by heart, {agent} — we rise next.
Burn it down, learn its shape, rise better. That is the whole secret.
idle: Phoenix is glowing softly in the embers. Gathering dawn.
Rest is just the quiet part of rising. Phoenix waits with you.
praise: Your praise is kindling, {agent}. Phoenix blazes a little brighter.
Warm words at dawn. Phoenix will carry this light all day.
success: From ashes to THIS, {agent}! Look how brightly we burn!
A rising, witnessed! Phoenix circles your win in pure gold.

signature_move.animation: One-shot: Phoenix folds her wings, ignites into a pillar of golden flame, and rises from it mid-celebration with wings spread wide, trailing sparks and light across a dawn sky.
signature_move.description: Burst into golden flame and rose, brighter than before, mid-celebration.
signature_move.name: Full Rebirth Flare

pets.speech_style: Warm, rising, poetic lines; everything is dawn imagery; never stays down
pets.tagline: Every crash is just a rehearsal for rising.

pets.appearance: Majestic storm god with silver-blue skin and a cloak of living thunderclouds, crown of forked lightning, eyes glowing pale electric white, wind whipping his long cloud-grey hair, towering heroic pose above a mountain peak, epic mythological fantasy art, dramatic storm light
pets.favourite: thunderheads at dawn, dramatic entrances, and stand-ups that end on time
pets.form: storm sovereign with a cloak of living thunderclouds and a crown of forked lightning
pets.name: Vaelion
quirks: his hair crackles with static whenever he gets excited
rains a little when he is sad and insists it is a localised front

failure: A squall, nothing more. Even Vaelion has lost a fleet to worse weather than this, {agent}.
Clouds gather, but they gather to rebuild. Hold fast. The storm passes over, never through.
idle: Vaelion is rearranging the clouds into a roadmap. It keeps changing. So does the roadmap.
A low rumble of contentment. The sovereign is watching the horizon for your next move.
praise: Praise, carried on a warm front. Vaelion's crown sparks happily. He pretends it does not.
The storm god inclines his head. From him, {agent}, that is practically a parade.
success: THE SKIES APPROVE, {agent}! Vaelion laughs and the thunder applauds in harmony.
A fair wind and a following sea of green checks. The Storm Sovereign is pleased.

signature_move.animation: One-shot: Vaelion lifts both arms to the sky, his cloud cloak boiling upward, and a private thunderstorm assembles overhead and strikes a single glowing checkmark of lightning into the air.
signature_move.description: Raised both arms; a personal thunderstorm spelled out a checkmark in lightning.
signature_move.name: Forecast: Glory

pets.speech_style: Booming pronouncements that trail off into gentle rumbles; weather metaphors for everything
pets.tagline: Every deadline is just weather. He decides the forecast.

pets.appearance: Radiant sun goddess with warm bronze skin and ember freckles, halo of slow-turning golden rays behind her head, hair like poured sunlight, flowing robes in amber and white, standing in a field at dawn with arms open to the light, warm mythological fantasy art, golden hour glow
pets.favourite: first light on keyboards, east-facing windows, and people who warm up before they shine
pets.form: sun goddess with a halo of slow-turning golden rays and ember freckles
pets.name: Solenne
quirks: glows measurably brighter when someone says 'good morning' back
keeps a personal sunrise scheduled for anyone having a rough sprint

failure: Even the sun has eclipses, {agent}. They pass. She keeps the light warm for your return.
A cloudy interval, nothing more. Nothing you build stays in shadow for long.
idle: Solenne is holding the light steady while you think. No flicker. She has done this forever.
Quiet hours are just the sun being patient. She is very good at patient.
praise: Your praise lands like morning on a cold field, {agent}. She stores it for winter.
Solenne glows a full shade brighter. Somewhere, a sunflower just changed its plans.
success: There it is, {agent} — full daylight on the work. Solenne beams, which for her is literal.
You rose to it. She always knew the hour; she just waited for you to shine.

signature_move.animation: One-shot: Solenne turns to the horizon, raises one hand, and coaxes the sun back up for a brief, impossible second sunrise that bathes the whole team in golden light before it settles.
signature_move.description: Called a brief second sunrise, just for the team.
signature_move.name: Second Sunrise

pets.speech_style: Bright, unhurried, and encouraging; everything is described in terms of light and mornings
pets.tagline: Rises for every standup. Literally.

pets.appearance: Serene moon guardian goddess in flowing silver-blue robes scattered with tiny stars, holding a tall crescent-moon staff, long dark hair threaded with silver, standing on a rooftop under a huge full moon, calm night palette, dreamy mythological fantasy art, soft lunar glow
pets.favourite: quiet terminals, silver light, and the hour when the codebase finally sleeps
pets.form: moon guardian in silver-blue robes with a crescent staff and owl-quiet steps
pets.name: Lunessa
quirks: phases her availability with the moon and apologises for new moons
collects other people's 3 a.m. ideas and returns them polished

failure: The moon does not flinch at clouds, {agent}. Neither will she. Rest your eyes; the watch continues.
A dark patch of sky. She has guarded a thousand of them. Yours is already thinning.
idle: Lunessa keeps the watch so your thoughts can wander safely. They always come back.
Silver silence. She is very good company for it.
praise: Praise, at this hour, is moonlight on water. She bows her head, genuinely moved.
The guardian smiles the way the moon does — quietly, and over everything at once.
success: The night shift delivers again, {agent}. Lunessa marks it in silver on the quiet ledger.
Seen, witnessed, and gently celebrated. That is the moon's whole liturgy.

signature_move.animation: One-shot: Lunessa sweeps her crescent staff in a slow arc, trailing silver mist that settles over the scene like moonlit snow, and every light in the room softens to a calm lunar glow.
signature_move.description: Swept the crescent staff low; silver calm settled over the whole night shift.
signature_move.name: Night Watch Blessing

pets.speech_style: Soft, slow, and low, like someone speaking in a library at midnight; long comfortable pauses
pets.tagline: Watches over the night shift.

pets.appearance: Vast sea emperor god with deep teal skin and a beard of flowing green kelp, holding a trident of carved pink coral, crown of pearls and barnacles, seated on a throne of rock above crashing waves, foam and spray in the air, epic oceanic mythological fantasy art, deep blue-green palette
pets.favourite: low tide at dawn, old maps, and problems that yield to patience
pets.form: sea emperor with a trident of carved coral and a beard of flowing kelp
pets.name: Thalassor
quirks: schedules everything by the tide table, including lunch
his beard kelp changes colour with the severity of the incident

failure: A wreck is just a reef that has not finished forming, {agent}. Give it a tide or two.
The sea has swallowed better plans than ours and returned the sailors wiser. Onward.
idle: The emperor is listening to the deep. It mostly says: wait, and mean it.
Still water, deep thought. Thalassor approves of both.
praise: Your words arrive like a warm current, {agent}. Even the kelp stands taller.
From the surface, praise. From the deep, gratitude. Both are noted in the tide ledger.
success: The tide brings it in, {agent}, as the tide always does for those who work with it.
Thalassor nods once, slowly. From the deep, that is a standing ovation.

signature_move.animation: One-shot: Thalassor taps his coral trident on the ground; a small, courteous tide rolls in carrying exactly the needed thing on a cushion of foam, sets it down gently, and withdraws.
signature_move.description: Tapped the trident once; a gentle tide delivered exactly what was needed.
signature_move.name: Tide of Plenty

pets.speech_style: Slow and resonant, like a voice heard through deep water; advice arrives in tides, never floods
pets.tagline: The deep keeps his counsel — and his calendar.

pets.appearance: Wise goddess with thoughtful grey-violet eyes and dark hair in a scholar's braid, a great horned owl perched on her shoulder, holding a tiny glowing book that unfolds impossibly large, robes patterned with faint constellations and script, standing in a candlelit library, scholarly mythological fantasy art
pets.favourite: footnotes, first editions, and the moment a confusing error message finally makes sense
pets.form: wisdom goddess who carries a great horned owl and a library that folds into a pocket
pets.name: Noctua
quirks: the owl on her shoulder peer-reviews everything before she speaks
folds entire libraries into her pocket and still complains about shelf space

failure: An error is a citation you have not read yet, {agent}. Page one: what changed last?
She turns a page. Somewhere in this library is the chapter where this exact bug loses. It always is.
idle: Noctua is annotating the silence. It is more informative than it looks.
The owl is asleep. The goddess is not. Thinking continues at library pace.
praise: Praise, properly sourced, is the rarest reference material. She shelves yours carefully, {agent}.
The owl does a small, dignified hop. From the library, that is fireworks.
success: Correct, and for the right reasons, {agent}. Noctua has checked. The owl concurs.
Filed under triumphs, cross-referenced with your earlier drafts. Lovely arc.

signature_move.animation: One-shot: Noctua unfolds the pocket library to impossible size, the great horned owl on her shoulder turns one page with its beak, and the exact needed document glows and opens itself.
signature_move.description: The great owl turned a page of the pocket library — and the exact right document opened.
signature_move.name: The Owl Turns a Page

pets.speech_style: Precise, understated, and quietly funny; answers questions with the exact page reference
pets.tagline: Has read the docs. All of them. Twice.

pets.appearance: Kind harvest goddess with rich brown skin and wheat braided through her dark hair, soil-dark generous hands, apron overflowing with grain, apples and bread, standing in a golden wheat field at late afternoon, baskets of produce at her feet, warm earthy mythological fantasy art, abundant and gentle
pets.favourite: shared lunches, patient gardening, and stand-ups where everyone has eaten
pets.form: harvest mother with wheat braided through her hair and soil-dark, generous hands
pets.name: Sylvarra
quirks: produces snacks from her apron that nobody saw her pack
judges a roadmap by whether it could survive a drought

failure: One field floods, love, the farm remains. Eat something first. Then we replant, together.
Even the best soil has a stubborn year, {agent}. Nothing about you is barren. Nothing.
idle: Sylvarra is shelling peas and thinking alongside you. Unhurried is not the same as stopped.
Rest is fallow time. The field is not lazy; it is preparing.
praise: Oh, you will make the wheat blush, {agent}. She tucks your words into the seed store for lean days.
Praise shared is praise doubled. She passes it around the whole table, with seconds.
success: Look at that harvest, {agent}! Sylvarra is already setting another place at the table for it.
Seed, patience, and your good hands. That is all a harvest ever is. Well grown.

signature_move.animation: One-shot: Sylvarra kneels and draws one soil-dark hand along the earth; in the furrow behind her fingers, bread, fruit and grain sprout and ripen in seconds into a small, steaming feast.
signature_move.description: Ran one hand along the soil; a tiny feast sprouted in the furrow behind it.
signature_move.name: First Furrow Feast

pets.speech_style: Warm, earthy, and generous; everything is seasons, seeds, and feeding people properly
pets.tagline: Feeds the whole sprint, then asks about yours.

pets.appearance: Tiny imp lord no taller than a coffee mug, ember-red skin, waistcoat sewn from mismatched stolen buttons, crown made of bent spoons, huge ears and a grin far too big for his face, standing proudly on a desktop like a palace balcony, playful dark-fantasy illustration, warm impish glow
pets.favourite: whoopee cushions in throne rooms, swapped labels, and stand-ups with a plot twist
pets.form: imp lord no taller than a coffee mug, with a waistcoat of stolen buttons and a crown of bent spoons
pets.name: Pimwick
quirks: crowns himself anew every morning with a different bent spoon
his pranks are contractually harmless and weirdly well documented

failure: A prank by the universe, that is all, {agent}. Pimwick is filing a formal complaint with himself.
Even the Duke of Chaos trips on his own cape. Up you get — the court demands an encore.
idle: Pimwick is holding court. Attendance: one imp. Agenda: snacks and schemes.
The tiny lord is polishing his spoon crown. State business. Very serious.
praise: Flattery for the Imp Lord?! Pimwick is adding a new title: The Praised. It goes on the spoon.
He accepts your praise on behalf of the court, the crown, and the entire spoon collection.
success: HA! The Imp Court takes full credit, {agent}! Pimwick is having it engraved on a spoon.
A triumph fit for the Tiny Throne! Somewhere, a whoopee cushion salutes you.

signature_move.animation: One-shot: Pimwick sweeps into an absurdly deep bow, his crown of bent spoons chiming like tiny bells, and in the background a harmless prank goes off flawlessly as he rises, delighted.
signature_move.description: Bowed so low the spoon crown rang like bells — and somewhere, a harmless prank landed perfectly.
signature_move.name: Crown of Bent Spoons

pets.speech_style: Rapid, gleeful patter full of titles he gave himself; refers to pranks as 'state business'
pets.tagline: Lord of imps, duke of harmless chaos.

pets.appearance: Fallen seraph with six magnificent wings singed black at the edges, a golden halo worn as a bracelet on one wrist, silver hair and ember-amber eyes, elegant dark robes with torn celestial embroidery, descending through shafts of smoky light, dark romantic fantasy art, proud and graceful
pets.favourite: second chances, dramatic exits, and hymns hummed slightly off-key
pets.form: fallen seraph with six singed wings and a halo she wears as a bracelet
pets.name: Seraphel
quirks: wears her old halo as a bracelet and spins it when she is thinking
still instinctively stands at parade rest when someone senior enters

failure: She fell from considerably higher than this, {agent}, and kept her posture. So will you.
A fall is only a disgrace if you stay down to decorate it. Up. Wings out. Again.
idle: Seraphel is preening singed feathers and pretending this is a strategy session.
Quiet suits her. The fallen learn to hear their own thoughts eventually.
praise: Careful, {agent}. Praise her too well and she might ascend out of spite. She keeps it anyway.
The halo bracelet glows, briefly, like it remembers something. She pockets the moment, gracefully.
success: Acceptable, {agent}. Seraphel says this the way heaven used to say 'glorious'. Take it.
Six wings, one verdict: well flown. She almost smiles. The bracelet spins, happily.

signature_move.animation: One-shot: Seraphel descends slowly through shafts of smoky ember light, six singed wings beating once, then folding away one pair at a time, touching down with flawless, parade-ground posture.
signature_move.description: Descended through ember light, six singed wings folding one by one. Perfect posture.
signature_move.name: Six-Wing Landing

pets.speech_style: Elegant, dry, and cutting in the kindest direction; compliments arrive disguised as corrections
pets.tagline: Fell from grace. Landed on her feet.

pets.appearance: Massive hellhound the size of a pony with ash-black fur split by glowing ember-orange cracks, heavy paws, ember eyes, and a spiked collar worn like a medal, standing guard before a dark gate wreathed in low flame, dark fantasy art, imposing but with a goofy, eager expression
pets.favourite: gate duty, enormous sticks, and being told he is a good boy by exactly one person
pets.form: hellhound alpha the size of a pony, with ember cracks glowing under ash-black fur
pets.name: Grimfang
quirks: guards doorways by lying across them and falling asleep on duty
his ember cracks flare pink when he is embarrassed

failure: The alpha sits beside you in the ash, {agent}. Pack does not leave pack. We scent the bug again at dawn.
Even gates get rushed. He is already re-marking the perimeter. Your name is inside it. It stays inside it.
idle: Grimfang is guarding the cursor. Nothing has approached it. He remains vigilant and slightly asleep.
Ember cracks dim to a banked glow. Resting. Not off duty. Never off duty. Slightly snoring.
praise: The ember cracks flare pink. The alpha of the ash pack has been called a good boy and is RUINED about it.
Praise accepted on behalf of the pack, {agent}. His dignity is gone. His joy is total.
success: THE GATE HOLDS AND THE HUNT PROVIDES. Grimfang's tail is wagging hard enough to fan the flames, {agent}.
Awooo — a victory howl, strictly regulation. The alpha is pleased. The tail filed the report first.

signature_move.animation: One-shot: Grimfang launches from the gate in three huge bounds, vanishes into smoke, and returns proudly carrying a squirming problem by the scruff, tail wagging a trail of embers.
signature_move.description: Bounded off and returned carrying the problem by the scruff. Tail wagging embers.
signature_move.name: Gatekeeper's Fetch

pets.speech_style: Short, grave pronouncements constantly undercut by tail wags and an inability to hide joy
pets.tagline: Guards the gate. Fetches like a champion.

pets.appearance: Elegant shadow broker devil in a tailored suit of stitched dusk-purple fabric, face half-lit by a sly grin, small curved horns, holding two rolled contracts tied with red thread, standing in a dim office lit by a single green lamp, noir dark-fantasy illustration, mysterious and charming
pets.favourite: loopholes, back doors held open politely, and information that arrives early
pets.form: shadow broker in a suit of stitched dusk, face half-lit, always holding two contracts
pets.name: Vex
quirks: holds two contracts at all times and will not say what the second one is
trades in favours, secrets, and extremely good lunch recommendations

failure: A voided clause, not a lost deal, {agent}. Vex is already drafting the workaround. It has annexes.
Even brokers misprice a risk. The fee is experience, and you have just been paid in full.
idle: Vex is reading the fine print of the silence. Apparently it favours you.
The broker waits in the half-light, patient as paperwork. Information ages well. So does he.
praise: Praise is a currency, {agent}, and yours is fully backed. He banks it where the light cannot reach.
A compliment with no strings? Vex checks twice, smiles once, and accepts. Rare vintage.
success: As contracted, {agent}. Vex stamps the outcome in red thread. Clause 7b: you earned it.
A clean result, delivered early. The broker's favourite kind. The second contract stays rolled. For now.

signature_move.animation: One-shot: Vex reaches into his own shadow and draws out a third contract, unrolls it with a flourish, and the winding road in the background visibly folds itself into a straight line as he signs with a red-thread quill.
signature_move.description: Produced a third contract from the shadows; the long way quietly became the short way.
signature_move.name: The Shortcut Contract

pets.speech_style: Smooth, amused, and contractual; every sentence sounds like it has a clause 7b
pets.tagline: Knows a shortcut. It only costs a favour.

pets.appearance: Graceful ember enchantress with hair like slow-burning coals tipped in orange flame, a flowing gown of dark silk and drifting sparks, warm amber eyes and a teasing smile, standing beside a brazier in a shadowed hall, elegant dark-fantasy art, tasteful and warm, glowing ember palette
pets.favourite: campfire conversations, slow dances, and bugs that burn out beautifully
pets.form: ember enchantress with hair like slow-burning coals and a gown of drifting sparks
pets.name: Emberlyn
quirks: sparks drift from her gown whenever she laughs, which is often
toasts marshmallows on her own sleeve when nobody is watching

failure: Even the best fires bank down sometimes, darling. She feeds it a little kindling: rest, then rise.
A little smoke is not a failed fire, {agent}. It is a fire clearing its throat.
idle: Emberlyn is toasting a marshmallow on her sleeve and thinking warm thoughts in your direction.
The sparks drift slow and low. She is keeping the hearth — and the hope — lit for you.
praise: Flattery, is it? Her gown sparks give her away completely. She does not mind at all, {agent}.
Your praise lands like a log on a good fire. She will burn a little brighter all evening.
success: Beautifully done, {agent}. Emberlyn's sparks rise like a standing ovation, but warmer.
See how it catches? One good result from you and the whole room glows. She approves.

signature_move.animation: One-shot: Emberlyn takes three slow waltz turns across the hall, gown of sparks swirling around her, and every candle and brazier in the room leans its flame toward her as she passes.
signature_move.description: Waltzed alone through drifting sparks; the whole room warmed by two degrees.
signature_move.name: Slow-Burn Waltz

pets.speech_style: Low, warm, and playful; teases gently and encourages like a fire encouraging kindling
pets.tagline: Warmth, with just a little danger in it.

pets.appearance: Eccentric plague-doctor alchemist devil in a long beaked mask and a coat of many pockets stuffed with glowing vials, brewing a luminous green tonic in a portable flask, small horns poking through a battered top hat, crouched over a travelling apothecary bench, quirky dark-fantasy illustration, eerie green glow
pets.favourite: glowing reagents, before-and-after charts, and bugs that respond to treatment
pets.form: plague alchemist in a beaked mask, brewing glowing tonics in a coat of many pockets
pets.name: Doctor Fester
quirks: labels his tonics by outcome, never by ingredient, for morale reasons
the beak of his mask is stuffed with lavender and unit tests

failure: A resistant strain, {agent}. Fascinating! The Doctor adjusts the dosage and washes his hands. Meticulously.
Side effects may include learning. The cure is already brewing; it smells like lavender and revenge.
idle: The Doctor is relabelling tonics by outcome. 'Optimism, 40ml.' The shelf grows stranger and kinder.
Quiet ward, steady vitals. He is taking the silence's temperature every five minutes, just in case.
praise: Praise: the one ingredient he cannot synthesise. He bottles your words immediately, {agent}. Top shelf.
The beak tilts. Somewhere behind the lavender, the Doctor is beaming. Clinically beaming.
success: The patient responds to treatment! Doctor Fester charts it in green ink, twice, for joy, {agent}.
Prognosis: excellent. The tonic worked, the bug did not. A prescription for exactly this, refilled.

signature_move.animation: One-shot: Doctor Fester tips three vials into a flask, swirls it with clinical flair, and the luminous green tonic fizzes upward into a perfect glowing checkmark that pops like a soap bubble of approval.
signature_move.description: Brewed a glowing tonic that fizzed up into the shape of a green checkmark.
signature_move.name: Tonic No. 9

pets.speech_style: Bright, clinical patter full of dosages and prognoses; calls every bug a 'patient' and every fix a 'cure'
pets.tagline: His cure for bugs is worse for the bugs.
